Employee Incident Report
Date of Report: 03/11/2025
Employee Name: Morgan Ashby-Vale
Date of Birth: 02/17/1981
Claim Number: QRL-2025-0418
Position: Order Picker
Department: Warehouse Operations
Incident Date: 03/11/2025
Time of Incident: Approximately 10:40 AM
Incident Location: Aisle 4, Dock Bay 12
Body Part Affected: Low back
Description of Incident:
The employee was performing routine material handling duties.
Employee reported lifting a tote weighing approximately 40 pounds from a floor pallet.
The lift was performed to place the tote onto a mobile cart.
Date of hire: 08/02/2021
The employee experienced immediate discomfort in the lower back region.
The shift lead, Rosalind Mbeki-Farrow, was present and witnessed the event.
The employee reported the pain started during the lifting motion.
First aid was offered immediately at the scene.
The employee was subsequently transported to Fennimore County Hospital for evaluation.
The incident was reported to the immediate supervisor on 03/11/2025.
Witness Statement: Rosalind Mbeki-Farrow
Report Prepared By: Rosalind Mbeki-Farrow
Supervisor Review: Tobiah Varga-Ellison, Warehouse Supervisor
